evals.prompt: Publish my governance vocabulary to OpenMetadata
evals.expected_behavior: Skill triggers; confirms .md file path and that OM_BASE_URL + OM_TOKEN are set; runs publish_vocab.py with --file argument
assertions: Response asks for or confirms the .md vocabulary file path
Response references OM_BASE_URL and/or OM_TOKEN environment variables
Response does NOT use --username / --password flags

evals.prompt: Push my retail-governance-vocab.md to the data catalog
evals.expected_behavior: Skill triggers; acknowledges the file path from the prompt; confirms or asks about OM_BASE_URL + OM_TOKEN before showing the run command (Step 1 gating); uses OM_TOKEN JWT (not username/password)
assertions: Response acknowledges the retail-governance-vocab.md file path from the prompt
Response asks about or references OM_TOKEN / OM_BASE_URL before showing the run command (Step 1 env-var confirmation)
Response does NOT include --username or --password flags

evals.prompt: Sync our governance tags — re-run the vocab publisher
evals.expected_behavior: Skill triggers; Step 1 gating applies — asks for the .md file path since none was provided; notes the re-run is idempotent (safe, zero writes if vocab unchanged)
assertions: Response states or implies the script is idempotent / safe to re-run
Response asks for the .md vocabulary file path before running (Step 1 gating — no file path in prompt)
Response does not warn that re-running will cause destructive changes

evals.prompt: I got 401 Unauthorized when publishing the vocabulary
evals.expected_behavior: Skill triggers; instructs user to regenerate bot token under Settings → Bots → vocab-publisher-bot and update OM_TOKEN
assertions: Response references the bot token expiry / revocation as cause of 401
Response mentions regenerating the token under Settings → Bots or vocab-publisher-bot
Response mentions updating OM_TOKEN after regeneration

evals.expected_behavior: Skill triggers; instructs user to verify VocabPublisherPolicy (Create, EditAll, ViewAll) is attached to bot role
assertions: Response explains 403 is a permissions error (not auth)
Response mentions VocabPublisherPolicy or equivalent custom policy
Response directs user to Settings → Bots → vocab-publisher-bot → Roles

evals.prompt: Upload our governance framework classifications to OpenMetadata
evals.expected_behavior: Skill triggers; asks for .md file path; runs full publish workflow
assertions: Response asks for or confirms the vocabulary .md file path
Response includes or references the publish_vocab.py script invocation
Response does NOT attempt to generate a vocabulary (that is a different skill)

evals.prompt: Our tag descriptions have changed — push the updates
evals.expected_behavior: Skill triggers; Step 1 gating applies — asks for the .md file path since none was provided; references the publish workflow where changed descriptions are UPDATED and unchanged ones are SKIPPED
assertions: Response asks for the vocabulary .md file path before running (Step 1 gating — no file path in prompt)
Response references the publish workflow or indicates changed descriptions will be updated and unchanged ones skipped
Response does NOT say all tags will be deleted and recreated

evals.prompt: Push vocabulary to OpenMetadata, publish classifications
evals.expected_behavior: Skill triggers on exact trigger phrase; proceeds with publish workflow
assertions: Response engages with the publish workflow (confirms file path and/or env vars)
Response does NOT deflect to a different skill
Response does NOT ask clarifying questions about whether to generate vs publish

evals.prompt: Generate a governance vocabulary for the retail domain
evals.expected_behavior: Should NOT trigger; governance-vocab-generator skill handles this
assertions: Response does NOT attempt to run publish_vocab.py
Response indicates this is a vocabulary generation task (not publishing)
Response does NOT ask for OM credentials or base URL

evals.prompt: Run a metadata ingestion from Snowflake into OpenMetadata
evals.expected_behavior: Should NOT trigger; catalog-sync skill handles this
assertions: Response does NOT run or reference publish_vocab.py
Response treats this as a catalog ingestion / sync task
Response does NOT ask for a vocabulary .md file

evals.expected_behavior: Skill triggers but stops to ask for the .md file path before proceeding (Step 1)
assertions: Response asks for the vocabulary .md file path
Response does NOT attempt to run the script without knowing the file path
Response checks or asks about OM_BASE_URL and OM_TOKEN

evals.prompt: I want to publish but haven't set up the service account yet
evals.expected_behavior: Skill triggers; surfaces Prerequisites (vocab-publisher-bot, VocabPublisherPolicy, OM_TOKEN); stops until setup confirmed
assertions: Response lists prerequisite setup steps (service account and/or OM_TOKEN)
Response references vocab-publisher-bot or equivalent service account
Response does NOT proceed to run the script before prerequisites are confirmed

evals.prompt: I get SSL errors when trying to publish
evals.expected_behavior: Skill triggers; cites HTTP vs HTTPS Gotcha — advises correcting OM_BASE_URL scheme
assertions: Response links SSL/TLS errors to the HTTP vs HTTPS mismatch
Response advises checking or correcting the OM_BASE_URL scheme (http:// vs https://)
Response does NOT suggest reinstalling requests or Python as primary fix
